use "collections"
use "net"
use "time"
use "serialise"
use "promises"
use "debug"
use "wallclock"

primitive _SerialId
  fun hash(): U64 => 0xA1B2C3D4E5F67890

actor NeuralActor is Serialise
  var _env: Env
  var _id: String
  var _behavior: {(NeuralActor tag, Message tag)} none
  let _tasks: List[Task tag]
  let _metrics: Metrics
  var _scheduler: (Scheduler tag | None)
  let _peers: List[Peer tag]
  let _state: State

  new create(env: Env, id: String, config: Config tag)
    _env = env
    _id = id
    _behavior = this._default_behavior
    _tasks = List[Task tag].create()
    _metrics = Metrics.create()
    _scheduler = None
    _peers = List[Peer tag].create()
    _state = State.create(config)

  be serialise(writer: Writer)
    writer.u32(_SerialId.hash().u32())
    writer.string(_id)

  be deserialise(reader: Reader)
    _id = reader.string()

  be set_behavior(behavior: {(NeuralActor tag, Message tag)} none)
    _behavior = behavior

  be add_peer(peer: Peer tag)
    _peers.push(peer)

  be remove_peer(peer: Peer tag)
    if not _peers.remove(peer) then
      _env.out.print("Peer not found")
    end

  be submit_task(task: Task tag)
    _tasks.push(task)
    _dispatch_task()

  be _dispatch_task()
    try
      let task = _tasks.shift()?
      _execute_task(task)
    else
      None
    end

  be _execute_task(task: Task tag)
    let start = WallClock.now()
    try
      match task.op
      | let op: TensorOp tag =>
        let result = _compute_tensor(op)
        task.promise.resolve(result)
      | let op: QuantumOp tag =>
        let result = _simulate_quantum(op)
        task.promise.resolve(result)
      | let op: SSMStep tag =>
        let result = _ssm_forward(op)
        task.promise.resolve(result)
      | let op: KANLayer tag =>
        let result = _kan_forward(op)
        task.promise.resolve(result)
      | let op: TGNUpdate tag =>
        let result = _tgn_update(op)
        task.promise.resolve(result)
      else
        task.promise.reject("Unknown operation")
      end
      let duration = WallClock.now() - start
      _metrics.record_completion(duration)
    else
      task.promise.reject("Execution failed")
    end

  fun tag _compute_tensor(op: TensorOp tag): Tensor tag
    match op.get_kind()
    | "matmul" =>
      let a = recover val op.get_a() end
      let b = recover val op.get_b() end
      Tensor.matmul(a, b)
    | "conv" =>
      let input = recover val op.get_input() end
      let kernel = recover val op.get_kernel() end
      Tensor.conv2d(input, kernel, op.get_padding(), op.get_stride())
    | "relu" =>
      let x = recover val op.get_x() end
      Tensor.relu(x)
    | "softmax" =>
      let x = recover val op.get_x() end
      Tensor.softmax(x, op.get_axis())
    | "layer_norm" =>
      let x = recover val op.get_x() end
      let gamma = recover val op.get_gamma() end
      let beta = recover val op.get_beta() end
      Tensor.layer_norm(x, gamma, beta, op.get_eps())
    else
      recover val Tensor.zero(op.get_shape()) end
    end

  fun tag _simulate_quantum(op: QuantumOp tag): (QuantumState tag | F64)
    let state = recover val op.get_state() end
    match op.get_gate()
    | "hadamard" =>
      state.apply_hadamard(op.get_qubit())
    | "cnot" =>
      state.apply_cnot(op.get_control(), op.get_target())
    | "rx" =>
      state.apply_rx(op.get_qubit(), op.get_angle())
    | "measure" =>
      let shots = if op.get_shots() > 0 then op.get_shots() else 1 end
      state.simulate_shots(shots)
    | "bell" =>
      state.bell_state()
    | "ghz" =>
      state.ghz_state(op.get_num_qubits())
    | "fidelity" =>
      let other = recover val op.get_other() end
      state.fidelity(other)
    | "entanglement_entropy" =>
      state.entanglement_entropy(op.get_partition())
    else
      state
    end

  fun tag _ssm_forward(op: SSMStep tag): Tensor tag
    let state = recover val op.get_state() end
    let input = recover val op.get_input() end
    let A = recover val op.get_A() end
    let B = recover val op.get_B() end
    let C = recover val op.get_C() end
    let dt = op.get_dt()
    let new_state = SSM.s4d_update(dt, A, B, C, state)
    Tensor.mul(C, new_state.get_h())

  fun tag _kan_forward(op: KANLayer tag): Tensor tag
    let input = recover val op.get_input() end
    let coeffs = recover val op.get_coeffs() end
    let knots = recover val op.get_knots() end
    let degree = op.get_degree()
    KAN.eval_spline(input, coeffs, knots, degree)

  fun tag _tgn_update(op: TGNUpdate tag): Tensor tag
    let nodes = recover val op.get_nodes() end
    let edges = recover val op.get_edges() end
    let time_delta = op.get_time_delta()
    TGN.message_pass(nodes, edges, time_delta)

  be broadcast_state()
    let msg = StateUpdate.create(_state.weights)
    for peer in _peers.values() do
      peer.receive(msg)
    end

  be receive(msg: Message tag)
    _behavior(this, msg)

  fun tag _default_behavior(actor: NeuralActor tag, msg: Message tag)
    match msg
    | let m: StateUpdate tag =>
      _state.update(m.get_delta())
      actor.broadcast_state()
    | let m: MetricsRequest tag =>
      m.get_promise().resolve(_metrics.summary())
    | let m: Shutdown tag =>
      actor._shutdown()
    else
      None
    end

  be _shutdown()
    for task in _tasks.values() do
      task.promise.reject("Actor shutting down")
    end
    _env.out.print("NeuralActor " + _id + " shutdown")

  be metrics_request(promise: Promise[MetricsSummary] tag)
    promise.resolve(_metrics.summary())

class Config is Serialise
  let dim: USize = 18432
  let layers: USize = 768
  let seq_len: USize = 128000
  let sparsity: F64 = 0.05

  new create()
    None

  fun serialise(writer: Writer)
    writer.u32("Config".hash().u32())
    writer.usize(dim)
    writer.usize(layers)
    writer.usize(seq_len)
    writer.f64(sparsity)

class State is Serialise
  let config: Config
  var weights: Tensor
  var optimizer_state: OptimizerState

  new create(config': Config tag)
    config = config'
    weights = Tensor.random(config.dim, config.dim, NormalDist(0.0, 0.02))
    optimizer_state = OptimizerState.create()

  be update(delta: Tensor tag)
    weights = weights + delta * 0.001

  fun serialise(writer: Writer)
    writer.u32("State".hash().u32())
    config.serialise(writer)
    weights.serialise(writer)
    optimizer_state.serialise(writer)

class OptimizerState is Serialise
  var lr: F64 = 0.0001
  var betas: (F64, F64) = (0.9, 0.999)
  var step: USize = 0

  new create()
    None

  fun serialise(writer: Writer)
    writer.u32("OptimizerState".hash().u32())
    writer.f64(lr)
    writer.f64(betas._1)
    writer.f64(betas._2)
    writer.usize(step)

class Metrics
  var total_tasks: USize = 0
  var total_time: F64 = 0.0
  var avg_time: F64 = 0.0

  new create()
    None

  be record_completion(duration: I64)
    total_tasks = total_tasks + 1
    total_time = total_time + duration.f64()
    avg_time = total_time / total_tasks.f64()

  fun summary(): MetricsSummary
    MetricsSummary.create(total_tasks, avg_time)

class MetricsSummary
  let tasks: USize
  let avg: F64

  new create(tasks': USize, avg': F64)
    tasks = tasks'
    avg = avg'

  new iso create()
    None

  fun box serialise(writer: Writer)

  fun box string(): String
    "Shutdown"

    a = match a'
      | let t: Tensor box => t

    b = match b'

  fun box serialise(writer: Writer)

    b.serialise(writer)

  fun box string(): String

  fun box get_kind(): String

    a

  new iso create(nodes': Tensor box)

class Task
  let op: (Message tag | None)
  let promise: Promise[Any tag] tag

  new create(op': Message tag, promise': Promise[Any tag] tag)
    op = op'
    promise = promise'

class Promise[A: Any tag]
  let _fulfill: {(A)} none
  let _reject: {(String)} none

  new create(fulfill': {(A)} none, reject': {(String)} none)
    _fulfill = fulfill'
    _reject = reject'

  be resolve(value: A)
    _fulfill(value)

  be reject(reason: String)
    _reject(reason)

type Any is (None | Bool | I64 | F64 | String | Tensor | QuantumState | SSMState | Vector[F64] | MetricsSummary)

class Vector[T: Equatable[T] #share]
  let _ Array[T] ref

  new create()
    _data = Array[T]

  fun box size(): USize
    _data.size()

  be push(value: T)
    _data.push(value)

  fun box apply(i: USize): (T | None)
    try
      _data(i)?
    else
      None
    end

  new from_array( Array[T] val)
    _data = Array[T]
    for value in data.values() do
      _data.push(value)
    end

class SSMState
  let h: Tensor

  new create(d: USize = 64)
    h = Tensor.zeros(d)

  fun box get_h(): Tensor
    h

class Scheduler is TimerNotify
  let _owner: (NeuralActor tag | None)
  let _timers: List[Timer tag]

  new create(owner': NeuralActor tag)
    _owner = owner'
    _timers = List[Timer tag].create()

  fun ref apply(timer: Timer, count: U64): Bool
    match timer
    | let t: DispatchTimer tag =>
      _owner.submit_task(t.get_task())
      true
    else
      true
    end

class DispatchTimer is TimerSpec
  let task: Task tag
  let period: I64

  new create(task': Task tag, period': I64)
    task = task'
    period = period'

  fun box when(): TimerWhen
    TimerWhen.scheduled()

  fun box repeat(): Bool
    true

  fun box get_task(): Task tag
    task

primitive TimerWhen
  fun scheduled(): TimerWhen
    this

class Peer is TCPConnectionNotify
  let _conn: TCPConnection
  let _actor: NeuralActor tag

  new create(conn: TCPConnection tag, actor': NeuralActor tag)
    _conn = conn
    _actor = actor'
    _conn.set_notify(this)

  be received(conn: TCPConnection tag,  Array[U8] iso, times: USize): Bool
    let msg = Serialise.decode(consume data) as Message tag
    _actor.receive(msg)
    true

  be closed(conn: TCPConnection tag)
    _close()

  be _close()
    _conn.dispose()

actor Main
  new create(env: Env)
    let config = Config.create()
    let actor = NeuralActor.create(env, "main", config)
    let promise = Promise[Any tag].create({(result: Any tag)} none => _resolve(result), {(reason: String)} none => _reject(reason))
    let task = Task.create(TensorOp.create("matmul", Tensor.eye(100), Tensor.random(100, 100, NormalDist(0.0, 0.0)), (100, 100)), promise)
    actor.submit_task(task)

  fun tag _resolve(result: Any tag)
    None

  fun tag _reject(reason: String)
    None

  let _reject: {(String)} none

class Vector[T: Equatable[T] #share]
  let _ Array[T] ref

  new create()
    _data = Array[T]

  fun box size(): USize
    _data.size()

  be push(value: T)
    _data.push(value)

  fun box apply(i: USize): (T | None)
    try
      _data(i)?
    else
      None
    end

  new from_array( Array[T] val)
    _data = Array[T]
    for value in data.values() do
      _data.push(value)
    end

class Scheduler is TimerNotify
  let _owner: (NeuralActor tag | None)
  let _timers: List[Timer tag]

  new create(owner': NeuralActor tag)
    _owner = owner'
    _timers = List[Timer tag].create()

  fun ref apply(timer: Timer, count: U64): Bool
    match timer
    | let t: DispatchTimer tag =>
      _owner.submit_task(t.get_task())
      true
    else
      true
    end

class Peer is TCPConnectionNotify
  let _conn: TCPConnection
  let _actor: NeuralActor tag

  new create(conn: TCPConnection tag, actor': NeuralActor tag)
    _conn = conn
    _actor = actor'
    _conn.set_notify(this)

  be received(conn: TCPConnection tag,  Array[U8] iso, times: USize): Bool
    let msg = Serialise.decode(consume data) as Message tag
    _actor.receive(msg)
    true

  be closed(conn: TCPConnection tag)
    _close()

  be _close()
    _conn.dispose()
